description.en: The Balearic Islands are an archipelago in the western Mediterranean Sea, off the eastern coast of the Iberian Peninsula, constituting an autonomous community and province of Spain, with Palma as their capital and largest city. With a population of 1,249,844, they are the 6th least populous autonomous community of Spain, and with an area of 4,991.70 square kilometres , the smallest.
description.zh-CN: 巴利阿里群島是位于西地中海的一片群島，也是西班牙的自治區之一。該群島是由馬略卡島、梅诺卡岛、伊維薩島與福门特拉岛四座主要島嶼與周圍其他小島組成。
description.zh-TW: 巴利阿里羣島是位於西地中海的一片羣島，也是西班牙的自治區之一。該羣島是由馬略卡島、梅諾卡島、伊維薩島與福門特拉島四座主要島嶼與周圍其他小島組成。
